cox_evaluate =: 3 : 0
    'subjects vectors beta' =. y
    size =. #beta
    predictors =. (#subjects)$0.0
    risks =. (#subjects)$0.0
    for_index. i.#subjects do.
        value =. 0.0
        for_c. i.size do.
            value =. value+(c{beta)*(<index,c){vectors
        end.
        predictors =. value index}predictors
        risks =. (^value)index}risks
    end.
    order =. /:(-2{"1 subjects),.0{"1 subjects
    s0 =. 0.0
    s1 =. size$0.0
    s2 =. (size,size)$0.0
    likelihood =. 0.0
    score =. size$0.0
    information =. (size,size)$0.0
    event_sums =. 0$a:
    position =. 0
    while. position<#order do.
        moment =. (<(position{order),2){subjects
        events =. i.0
        while. position<#order do.
            index =. position{order
            if. moment~:(<index,2){subjects do.
                break.
            end.
            risk =. index{risks
            vector =. index{vectors
            s0 =. s0+risk
            for_c. i.size do.
                s1 =. ((c{s1)+risk*c{vector)c}s1
                for_d. i.size do.
                    value =. ((<c,d){s2)+(risk*c{vector)*d{vector
                    s2 =. value (<c,d)}s2
                end.
            end.
            if. 1=(<index,3){subjects do.
                events =. events,index
            end.
            position =. position+1
        end.
        count =. #events
        if. count=0 do.
            continue.
        end.
        likelihood =. likelihood+(ordered_sum events{predictors)-count*^.s0
        for_c. i.size do.
            sum_x =. +/c{"1 events{vectors
            score =. ((c{score)+(sum_x-(count*c{s1)%s0))c}score
            for_d. i.size do.
                increment =. count*((((<c,d){s2)%s0)-((c{s1)%s0)*(d{s1)%s0)
                information =. (((<c,d){information)+increment)(<c,d)}information
            end.
        end.
        event_sums =. event_sums,<(<moment),(<count),(<s0),<s1
    end.
    (<likelihood),(<score),(<information),(<predictors),<event_sums
)
cox_fit =: 3 : 0
    'subjects vectors' =. y
    beta =. (1{$vectors)$0.0
    null =. cox_evaluate (<subjects),(<vectors),<beta
    current =. null
    iterations =. 0$a:
    for_iteration. 1+i.25 do.
        change =. solve (<c_information current),<c_score current
        beta =. beta+change
        iterations =. iterations,<(<iteration),(<c_loglik current),<beta
        current =. cox_evaluate (<subjects),(<vectors),<beta
    end.
    (<beta),(<null),(<current),<iterations
)

risk_sets =: 3 : 0
    moments =. /:~~.2{"1 y
    result =. 0 4$0
    for_moment. moments do.
        at_time =. moment=2{"1 y
        risk =. +/moment<:2{"1 y
        deaths =. +/at_time*.3{"1 y
        censored =. (+/at_time)-deaths
        result =. result,moment,risk,deaths,censored
    end.
    result
)
kaplan_meier =: 3 : 0
    risks =. risk_sets y
    event_rows =. risks#~0<2{"1 risks
    event_times =. 0{"1 event_rows
    result =. 0 10$0.0
    survival =. 1.0
    greenwood =. 0.0
    hazard =. 0.0
    variance =. 0.0
    for_index. i.#event_rows do.
        'moment n d censored' =. index{event_rows
        survival =. survival*(n-d)fraction n
        standard_error =. _1.0
        lower =. _1.0
        upper =. _1.0
        if. n~:d do.
            greenwood =. greenwood+d fraction n*(n-d)
        end.
        if. survival~:0.0 do.
            standard_error =. survival*%:greenwood
            logarithm =. ^.survival
            omega =. (Z95*%:greenwood)%-logarithm
            lower =. ^logarithm*^omega
            upper =. ^logarithm*^-omega
        end.
        hazard =. hazard+d fraction n
        variance =. variance+d fraction n*n
        following =. 10000
        if. (index+1)<#event_times do.
            following =. (index+1){event_times
        end.
        censored =. +/(0=3{"1 y)*.(moment<:2{"1 y)*.(following>2{"1 y)
        result =. result,moment,n,d,censored,survival,standard_error,lower,upper,hazard,%:variance
    end.
    result
)

life_table =: 3 : 0
    'subjects width count' =. y
    survival =. 1.0
    variance =. 0.0
    result =. 0 10$0.0
    for_interval. i.count do.
        start =. interval*width
        finish =. (interval+1)*width
        moments =. 2{"1 subjects
        in_interval =. (moments>:start)*.moments<finish
        n =. +/moments>:start
        d =. +/in_interval*.3{"1 subjects
        c =. (+/in_interval)-d
        exposed =. (2*n)-c
        survival =. survival*(exposed-2*d)fraction exposed
        variance =. variance+(4*d)fraction exposed*(exposed-2*d)
        result =. result,start,finish,n,d,c,(exposed%2.0),((2*d)fraction exposed),survival,(survival*%:variance),(2000*d)fraction width*(exposed-d)
    end.
    result
)

weighted_totals =: 3 : 0
    'subjects groups weight population_size' =. y
    size =. #groups
    deaths_total =. size$0
    observed =. size$0.0
    expected =. size$0.0
    covariance =. (size,size)$0.0
    for_row. risk_sets subjects do.
        if. 0=2{row do.
            continue.
        end.
        moment =. 0{row
        risks =. size$0
        deaths =. size$0
        for_h. i.size do.
            group_mask =. (h{groups)=1{"1 subjects
            risks =. (+/group_mask*.moment<:2{"1 subjects)h}risks
            deaths =. (+/group_mask*.(moment=2{"1 subjects)*.3{"1 subjects)h}deaths
        end.
        n =. +/risks
        d =. +/deaths
        value =. 1.0
        if. weight=1 do.
            value =. n fraction population_size
        elseif. weight=2 do.
            value =. %:n fraction population_size
        end.
        for_h. i.size do.
            deaths_total =. ((h{deaths_total)+h{deaths)h}deaths_total
            observed =. ((h{observed)+value*h{deaths)h}observed
            expected =. ((h{expected)+value*(d*h{risks)fraction n)h}expected
            if. n<2 do.
                continue.
            end.
            factor =. (value*value)*(d*(n-d))fraction ((n-1)*n)*n
            for_other. i.size do.
                multiple =. -(h{risks)*other{risks
                if. h=other do.
                    multiple =. (h{risks)*(n-h{risks)
                end.
                covariance =. (((<h,other){covariance)+factor*multiple)(<h,other)}covariance
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<groups),(<deaths_total),(<observed),(<expected),<covariance
)
finish_test =: 3 : 0
    degrees =. <:(#t_groups y)
    difference =. degrees{.(t_observed y)-t_expected y
    coefficients =. (degrees,degrees){.t_covariance y
    solution =. solve (<coefficients),<difference
    statistic =. ordered_sum difference*solution
    y,(<statistic),(<degrees),<statistic chi_p degrees
)
weighted_test =: 3 : 'finish_test weighted_totals y'
combine_strata =: 3 : 0
    'strata groups' =. y
    'stored events observed expected covariance' =. empty_totals groups
    for_box. strata do.
        stratum =. >box
        events =. events+t_events stratum
        observed =. observed+t_observed stratum
        expected =. expected+t_expected stratum
        covariance =. covariance+t_covariance stratum
    end.
    finish_test (<groups),(<events),(<observed),(<expected),<covariance
)

restricted_mean =: 4 : 0
    selected =. x#~y>:0{"1 x
    moments =. 0,(<.0{"1 selected),y
    survival =. 1.0,4{"1 selected
    count =. #survival
    tails =. count$0.0
    for_index. |.i.count do.
        rectangle =. (index{survival)*((index+1){moments)-index{moments
        if. index=count-1 do.
            value =. rectangle
        else.
            value =. rectangle+(index+1){tails
        end.
        tails =. value index}tails
    end.
    variance =. 0.0
    for_index. i.#selected do.
        n =. <.(<index,1){selected
        d =. <.(<index,2){selected
        tail =. (index+1){tails
        variance =. variance+(tail*tail)*d fraction n*(n-d)
    end.
    estimate =. 0{tails
    standard_error =. %:variance
    estimate,standard_error,(estimate-Z95*standard_error),estimate+Z95*standard_error
)

summarize =: 3 : 0
    subjects =. y
    rows =. kaplan_meier subjects
    life =. life_table (<subjects),(<LifeWidth),<LifeIntervals
    events =. event_count subjects
    days =. +/2{"1 subjects
    maximum =. >./2{"1 subjects
    reverse =. subjects
    for_index. i.#reverse do.
        reverse =. (1-(<index,3){subjects)(<index,3)}reverse
    end.
    rate =. (1000*events)fraction days
    eta =. Z95%%:events
    life_median =. _1.0
    previous =. 1.0
    for_row. life do.
        if. (7{row)<:0.5 do.
            life_median =. (0{row)+((LifeWidth*(previous-0.5))%(previous-7{row))
            break.
        end.
        previous =. 7{row
    end.
    percentiles =. 0 4$0
    for_index. i.3 do.
        threshold =. index{0.75 0.5 0.25
        percentile =. 25*index+1
        for_column. 4 6 7 do.
            percentile =. percentile,percentile_time (<rows),(<threshold),<column
        end.
        percentiles =. percentiles,percentile
    end.
    followup =. percentile_time (<kaplan_meier reverse),(<0.5),<4
    (<rows),(<life),(<#subjects),(<events),(<maximum),(<days),(<rate),(<^(^.rate)-eta),(<^(^.rate)+eta),(<followup),(<life_median),(<percentiles),<rows restricted_mean Tau
)

    variance =. 0.0
    for_age. ages do.

    end.
    ages =. /:~ages
    median =. (((<.(count-1)%2){ages)+(<.count%2){ages)%2.0

)
kruskal =: 3 : 0
    order =. /:(4{"1 Subjects),.0{"1 Subjects
    ranks =. (#Subjects)$0.0
    ties =. 0
    position =. 0
    while. position<#order do.
        finish =. position
        while. finish<#order do.
            if. ((<(finish{order),4){Subjects)~:(<(position{order),4){Subjects do.
                break.
            end.
            finish =. finish+1
        end.
        rank =. ((position+1)+finish)%2.0
        indices =. (position+i.finish-position){order
        ranks =. rank indices}ranks
        count =. finish-position
        ties =. (ties+((count*count)*count))-count
        position =. finish
    end.
    weighted =. 0.0
    for_group. i.#Groups do.
        mask =. group=1{"1 Subjects
        sum =. ordered_sum mask#ranks
        weighted =. weighted+(sum*sum)%+/mask
    end.
    count =. #Subjects
    raw =. ((12.0*weighted)%(count*(count+1)))-3*(count+1)
    raw%(1.0-ties fraction ((count*count)*count)-count)
)
contingency =: 3 : 0
    column =. variable_column y

            expected =. ((#members)*column_count)fraction #Subjects
            difference =. observed-expected
            statistic =. statistic+(difference*difference)%expected
        end.
    end.
    statistic,((#Groups)-1)*((#levels)-1)
)

overall_lines =: 3 : 0
    lines =. 0$a:
    stored =. 0$a:

        result =. weighted_test (<Subjects),(<i.#Groups),(<weight),<#Subjects
        stored =. stored,<result

    end.
    logrank =. 0{::stored

        trend =. trend+(g+1)*((g{t_observed logrank)-g{t_expected logrank)

            inner =. inner+((g+1)*(h+1))*(<g,h){t_covariance logrank

        variance =. variance+inner
    end.
    statistic =. (trend*trend)%variance
    lines,<'test logrank_trend chisq ',(number statistic),' df 1 p ',number statistic chi_p 1

two_group =: 3 : 0
    'subjects groups' =. y
    result =. weighted_test (<subjects),(<groups),(<0),<#Subjects
    observed =. t_observed result
    expected =. t_expected result
    ratio =. ((1{observed)%1{expected)%((0{observed)%0{expected)
    variance =. (1.0%0{expected)+1.0%1{expected
    logarithm =. ^.ratio
    lower =. ^logarithm-Z95*%:variance
    upper =. ^logarithm+Z95*%:variance
    (<result),(<ratio),(<variance),(<logarithm),(<lower),<upper
)
pairwise_lines =: 3 : 0
    pairs =. 0 2$0
    results =. 0$a:
    for_a. i.(#Groups)-1 do.
        for_b. (a+1)+i.(#Groups)-a+1 do.
            pair =. a,b
            pairs =. pairs,pair
            selected =. Subjects group_subset pair
            results =. results,<two_group (<selected),<pair
        end.
    end.
    probabilities =. t_probability@q_test&>results
    order =. /:probabilities,.i.#pairs
    adjusted =. (#pairs)$0.0
    previous =. 0.0
